Name: Simple Trade World Market
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#F2C879]Simple Trade World Market[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/color][/heading]
PC single-player • Stardew Valley 1.6.15 • SMAPI 4.4.0 or later

A different selling market every day. Check which goods are rising, keep an eye on your favourites, and choose when to sell or fulfil a trade contract.
Requested by Harold45.

[heading][color=#F2C879]📦 Daily Prices & Market Board[/color][/heading]
Daily selling-price changes cover 340 eligible vanilla goods across crops, forage, fish, animal products, artisan goods, food, gems, minerals and listed ores/bars.
The Rates table shows each item's Before and Now gold value, plus its whole-number percentage change. The inset search field has a magnifier, typing cursor and clear button; type to filter the list immediately. Category and backpack filters help narrow the goods. Select Item, Before, Now or Change to sort that column, then select it again to reverse the direction; arrows show the selected direction. The board keeps the same window size across tabs, searches and empty results, and adapts when the available game UI viewport changes.
Catalogue quotes use normal quality. Backpack quotes separate quality and ingredient variants, so a particular Wine or Roe can show its own selling value. Normal selling modifiers and professions remain part of the underlying quote.
The day's prices also apply to that day's shipping payout. Regular shop-stock purchase prices stay unchanged; native buyback offers can use the adjusted selling value.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54255/54255-1792591452-444892658.png[/img][/center]

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]✨ History, Watchlist & Bulletin[/color][/heading]
Select an item to see its price components and seven or fourteen days of recorded percentage history. History builds as you play.
Pin up to 50 goods, reorder your watchlist, and set individual selling alerts. Each watched item can notify you once per selling day when its threshold is reached.
The Bulletin highlights the biggest rises and falls, with matching item icons and Before/Now normal-quality gold prices per item. Ingredient-dependent goods direct you to your backpack for an exact variant quote.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54255/54255-1792591453-1208367412.png[/img][/center]

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]✨ Events, Seasons & Bulk Sales[/color][/heading]
Brewery Shortage raises selected alcohol rates, Bumper Harvest lowers crop rates, and Seafood Festival raises fish rates. These are market events shown on the board.
Optional seasonal pricing follows each crop, fruit, forage and fish item's natural seasons. The seasonal component is -10 percentage points in its natural season and +10 points outside it. Year-round goods and goods without a reliable seasonal calendar remain neutral.
Snow Yams have a winter season, so their seasonal component is lower in winter and higher in spring. Item details show the natural seasons. Daily randomness, events and pressure still contribute, and the final rate respects your price limits.
Crop and fruit-tree calendars use ordinary outdoor harvest seasons. Forage and fish combine natural locations, including tropical fishing where applicable. Magic Bait and fishing minigames do not extend an item's calendar. Optional bulk-sale pressure uses the previous seven completed selling days: heavy sales of one item can lower its future rate, then recover as older sales leave the window.
Events, seasonal demand and pressure each have their own switch and respect your configured price limits.

[heading][color=#F2C879]📦 Trade Contracts[/color][/heading]
Choose from up to three daily offers, with one active contract at a time. Deliver 10, 20 or 30 matching goods from your backpack, at normal, silver, gold or iridium quality, including mixed-quality stacks. Payment is fixed from the acceptance day's normal-quality market quote plus a 10% premium.
Review the quantity, payment and deadline before confirming. You have the acceptance day and two following selling days to deliver the full amount. Cancelling or letting a contract expire has no fine.
Deliveries use lower-quality goods first, then backpack slot order. Higher quality adds no extra payment, so review the quote before handing it in. Ingredient-dependent, recipe and quest goods are excluded from contract deliveries.

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]✨ Make the Market Yours[/color][/heading]
Choose Gentle, Balanced or Wild presets, or set custom maximum decreases from 0–75% and increases from 0–400%. A +400% increase means five times the underlying selling value.
Soft, Normal and Hard intensity adjust the spread of random price changes. Balanced defaults to a maximum 25% decrease and 25% increase with Normal intensity.
Economic settings take effect on the next selling day; today's quoted prices stay fixed.
English, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish and Simplified Chinese are included.

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🎨 Themes & UI Size[/color][/heading]
Open [b]Settings at the top right[/b] of this mod’s menu, then choose [b]Themes[/b] or [b]UI size[/b].
Choose [b]Slate, Navy, Ocean, Forest, Lavender, Rose, Graphite or Aurora[/b], or keep [b]Original[/b] for the existing appearance.
UI size presets are [b]75%, 90%, 100%, 110%, 125% and 150%[/b]. The default is [b]Original at 100%[/b]. Larger requests fit within the available game UI viewport; the preview shows the fitted size.
[b]Save[/b] stores the theme and size for this mod. [b]Cancel, Escape or controller B[/b] restores the previous preferences and returns to the same page. Each mod keeps its own selection.
Appearance choices do not change prices, rewards, contracts or wallet balances. Mouse, keyboard and controller controls follow the scaled menu.

Original also keeps the market’s [b]Dark/Light[/b] choice. The warm gold-brown Dark palette remains the default.

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]✨ World Trade Computer[/color][/heading]
Craft a three-monitor trading desk with 10 Iron Bars, 10 Copper Bars and 5 Battery Packs. The recipe is available in the normal crafting menu when a supported single-player save loads.
Place it as furniture with a footprint three tiles wide and two tiles deep. It faces forward and uses normal furniture placement, pickup and saving.
Interact with the computer nearby to open the same World Market board as the backpack shortcut and optional phone app.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54255/54255-1792701080-1454528380.png[/img][/center]
World Trade Computer beside vanilla furniture — native game rendering.

[heading][color=#C8B0F4]⚙️ Open & Use[/color][/heading]
Press Left Alt + M or use the market icon on the normal backpack page.
Controller: hold the left shoulder button and click the right stick. Use directional focus, A to confirm, B to go back, and shoulder buttons for pages.
With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] installed, select the gold World Market app icon on your phone to open the market board. The phone closes as the board opens, and the app name follows your game language. Mobile Phone is optional.
Optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] provides another way to change settings and rebind the shortcut.

[heading][color=#C8B0F4]⚙️ Requirements & Installation[/color][/heading]
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.4.0 or later[/url] and Stardew Valley 1.6.15 on PC.
Extract the SimpleTradeWorldMarket folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder, then launch through SMAPI.
Keep the mod's data folder to retain its daily settings records. Multiplayer and split-screen pricing are disabled. This edition does not support Android.
Shops still choose which goods they accept. Foreign custom sale callbacks and non-gold shops retain their own prices. Avoid combining multiple mods that replace the same selling-price rules.

Menu screenshots use native game rendering with arranged market data.

[heading][color=#F2C879]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/color][/heading]
Please share reports and ideas on this mod's page. For bugs, include the mod version, game/SMAPI version and platform, what happened versus what you expected, steps to reproduce, and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url]. A screenshot or short video helps when useful.
For suggestions, tell me what you would like changed or added and how it would improve the mod.
